title: MUGEN: Interactive Panoramic World Exploration via Camera Control

paragraphs.en: Interactive panoramic video generation aims to synthesize immersive 360° videos that remain visually coherent while following user-specified camera trajectories during exploration. However, progress is limited by a coupled data-and-model gap: existing panoramic video datasets are often short, weakly annotated, or lack camera trajectories, while existing camera-controlled video generation models are designed for perspective videos and do not directly support panoramic geometry. In this paper, we introduce MUGEN and Wan360 to address these limitations. MUGEN is a large-scale real-world panoramic video dataset tailored to interactive 360° world exploration, comprising over 1,300 hours of at least 4K panoramic videos with rich semantic and geometric annotations. Built on MUGEN, we further present Wan360 , a camera-controllable interactive panoramic video generation model. Panoramic videos are commonly represented by EquiRectangular Projection (ERP), which unfolds a spherical 360° view into a rectangular frame with cyclic longitude seams and pole distortions. To this end, Wan360 introduces three parameter-free ERP-aware components: periodic longitude RoPE for seam-consistent positional encoding, ERP-aware padding for reducing boundary artifacts, and random roll yaw for consistent learning. For camera control, Wan360 uses a panoramic Plücker embedding that represents camera motion with ERP rays rather than perspective pinhole rays. Experiments show that MUGEN serves as a data foundation for panoramic world exploration, and that Wan360 enables high-quality, temporally coherent, camera-controllable 360° video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 交互式全景视频生成旨在合成沉浸式360°视频，使其在探索过程中遵循用户指定的相机轨迹的同时保持视觉连贯性。 然而，进展受到数据与模型双重差距的制约：现有全景视频数据集往往时长较短、标注较弱或缺乏相机轨迹，而现有的相机可控视频生成模型是为透视图（perspective）视频设计的，无法直接支持全景几何。 在本文中，我们提出 MUGEN 和 Wan360 来解决这些局限。 MUGEN 是一个面向交互式360°世界探索的大规模真实世界全景视频数据集，包含超过1,300小时、分辨率至少4K的全景视频，并具有丰富的语义与几何标注。 在 MUGEN 的基础上，我们进一步提出了 Wan360，一个相机可控的交互式全景视频生成模型。 全景视频通常采用等距柱状投影（ERP）表示，该投影将球形的360°视野展开为具有循环经度接缝和极点畸变的矩形帧。 为此，Wan360 引入了三个无参数的 ERP 感知组件：用于接缝一致位置编码的周期经度 RoPE、用于减少边界伪影的 ERP 感知填充，以及用于一致性学习的随机滚转偏航（random roll yaw）。 在相机控制方面，Wan360 使用全景 Plücker 嵌入，以 ERP 光线而非透视针孔光线来表示相机运动。 实验表明，MUGEN 可作为全景世界探索的数据基础，而 Wan360 能够实现高质量、时间连贯、相机可控的360°视频生成。

paragraphs.en: Panoramic videos provide complete 360° visual observations of real-world environments, making them a natural medium for immersive world exploration in virtual reality, simulation, and embodied AI ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Chiariotti, 2021 ; Anderson et al., 2018 ) . For such exploration to be truly interactive, a generative system must satisfy three requirements simultaneously: it should synthesize high-fidelity panoramic content, maintain temporal and spherical consistency over time, and follow user-specified camera trajectories during generation. Recent advances in panoramic video generation have improved the visual quality of 360° videos ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Tan et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2025 ) , but interactive panoramic world exploration remains underdeveloped because both the data and the model architectures are still insufficient for controllable generation in dynamic real-world scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 全景视频为真实世界环境提供完整的360°视觉观察，使其成为虚拟现实、模拟和具身智能中沉浸式世界探索的天然媒介（ Yin et al., 2025 ; Chiariotti, 2021 ; Anderson et al., 2018 ）。 要使这种探索真正具有交互性，生成系统必须同时满足三个要求：合成高保真度的全景内容、在时间上和球面上保持一致性，以及在生成过程中遵循用户指定的相机轨迹。 全景视频生成领域的最新进展提升了360°视频的视觉质量（ Wang et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Tan et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2025 ; Yin et al., 2025 ），但交互式全景世界探索仍未充分发展，因为无论是数据还是模型架构，都尚不足以支持动态真实场景中的可控生成。

paragraphs.en: From the data perspective, existing panoramic video datasets are not designed for world exploration. Generation-oriented datasets ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Xia et al., 2025 ) mainly provide short captioned clips, which are useful for text-conditioned panoramic synthesis but do not provide explicit camera-trajectory annotations. Perception-oriented datasets ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2025 ; Yan et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) include masks, boxes, or tracking annotations, but they are typically limited in scale and duration and do not target camera control video generation. As a result, prior datasets rarely combine high-resolution real-world panoramic videos, minute-level temporal extent, semantic annotations, and geometric annotations such as camera trajectories. Lacking of such a dataset makes it difficult to train and evaluate models that can generate long, coherent, and controllable panoramic videos. To address this data gap, we introduce MUGEN , shown in Figure 1 , a large-scale real-world panoramic video dataset tailored to interactive 360° world exploration. MUGEN contains over 1,300 hours of high-fidelity panoramic videos at a resolution of at least 4K, with source videos longer than one minute and standardized one-minute clips for annotation and training. Each clip is paired with rich semantic annotations, including captions, scene categories, actions, weather, crowd density, and locations, as well as geometric annotations including camera trajectories, instance masks, and depth. To construct MUGEN, we design an automatic pipeline that collects panoramic videos from curated YouTube channels, performs format and content filtering, segments videos into minute-level clips, and annotates them using large multimodal models and geometry estimation tools. We further construct MUGEN-HQ, a 300-hour high-quality subset selected by quality and diversity, to support efficient model training and evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 从数据角度来看，现有的全景视频数据集并非为世界探索而设计。 面向生成的数据集（Wang et al., 2024; Xia et al., 2025）主要提供简短配字说明的视频片段，这些片段虽然对文本条件下的全景合成有用，但不提供显式的相机轨迹标注。 面向感知的数据集（Huang et al., 2023; Xu et al., 2025; Yan et al., 2024; Zhang et al., 2025b）包含掩码、边界框或跟踪标注，但它们通常在规模和时长上受限，且并非面向相机控制视频生成。 因此，先前的数据集很少同时具备高分辨率真实世界全景视频、分钟级时间跨度、语义标注以及相机轨迹等几何标注。 缺乏这样的数据集，使得训练和评估能够生成长时、连贯且可控全景视频的模型变得困难。 为填补这一数据空白，我们推出了如图1所示的MUGEN，这是一个专为交互式360°世界探索打造的大规模真实世界全景视频数据集。 MUGEN包含超过1,300小时、分辨率至少为4K的高保真全景视频，其中源视频时长超过一分钟，并配有标准化的用于标注和训练的一分钟片段。 每个片段均配有丰富的语义标注，包括说明文字、场景类别、动作、天气、人群密度和地点，以及相机轨迹、实例掩码和深度等几何标注。 为构建MUGEN，我们设计了一套自动化流程，该流程从精选的YouTube频道收集全景视频，执行格式与内容过滤，将视频切分为分钟级片段，并利用大型多模态模型和几何估计工具进行标注。 我们还构建了MUGEN-HQ，这是一个从质量和多样性角度精选出的300小时高质量子集，用以支持高效的模型训练与评估。

paragraphs.en: From the model perspective, directly extending existing video generation models to interactive panoramic generation is also non-trivial. Panoramic videos are usually represented in equirectangular projection (ERP), whose geometry differs fundamentally from ordinary perspective frames: longitude is periodic, the left and right image boundaries correspond to the same seam, and the top and bottom rows collapse near the poles. Treating ERP frames as standard rasters can therefore introduce seam artifacts, pole artifacts, and spherical inconsistencies. To address this model gap, we propose Wan360 , a camera-controllable panoramic image-to-video model trained on MUGEN-HQ. Wan360 is fine-tuned from the perspective camera-control baseline Wan2.2-Fun-5B-Control-Camera ( Wan et al., 2025 ) and adapts it to ERP panoramas through three parameter-free ERP-aware components. Periodic longitude RoPE enforces cyclic positional encoding along the horizontal longitude dimension, ERP-aware padding reduces seam artifacts in VAE encoding and decoding, and random roll yaw exposes the model to yaw-equivalent panoramic observations while preserving the corresponding camera trajectories. For camera control, Wan360 uses a panoramic Plücker embedding ( Ji et al., 2025 ) , replacing perspective pinhole rays with ERP rays to enable trajectory conditioning without conventional camera intrinsics. These components allow Wan360 to reuse the pretrained video generation baseline while avoiding additional trainable modules.
paragraphs.zh: 从模型角度来看，直接将现有的视频生成模型扩展到交互式全景生成也并非易事。 全景视频通常以等距柱状投影（ERP）表示，其几何结构与普通透视帧存在本质差异：经度是周期性的，图像左右边界对应同一条接缝，而顶部和底部行在极点附近塌缩。 因此，将ERP帧当作标准栅格处理可能引入接缝伪影、极点伪影以及球面不一致性。 为了解决这一模型层面的空白，我们提出了Wan360，这是一个在MUGEN-HQ上训练的相机可控全景图生视频模型。 Wan360 从透视相机控制基线 Wan2.2-Fun-5B-Control-Camera（Wan et al., 2025）微调而来，并通过三个无参数的ERP感知组件将其适配到ERP全景。 周期经度RoPE沿水平经度维度施加循环位置编码，ERP感知填充减少了VAE编码和解码中的接缝伪影，而随机滚动偏航则让模型接触偏航等价的全景观测，同时保留相应的相机轨迹。 在相机控制方面，Wan360 采用全景Plücker嵌入（Ji et al., 2025），用ERP光线替代透视针孔光线，从而无需传统相机内参即可实现轨迹条件控制。 这些组件使Wan360能够复用预训练的视频生成基线，同时避免引入额外的可训练模块。

paragraphs.en: Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of both MUGEN and Wan360. We evaluate the annotation quality of MUGEN and show that its semantic and geometric annotations provide reliable data support for interactive panoramic world exploration. We further compare Wan360 with existing panoramic video generation methods and conduct ablations on its ERP-aware components. The results show that Wan360 achieves strong panoramic video quality, temporal coherence, and camera-trajectory controllability, indicating that the improvements come from both the scale and quality of MUGEN and the proposed ERP-aware components.

paragraphs.en: Existing panoramic video datasets mainly support either generation or perception. Generation-oriented datasets such as WEB360 ( Wang et al., 2024 ) and PANOVID ( Xia et al., 2025 ) provide captioned panoramic clips for text-conditioned synthesis, but their annotations are primarily semantic and lack explicit camera trajectories. 360-1M ( Wallingford et al., 2024 ) targets static novel view synthesis from frame pairs, PanFlow ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) curates a motion-rich panoramic dataset with frame-level pose and flow annotations tailored to optical-flow-conditioned motion control, whereas MUGEN provides trajectories and richer annotations, better suiting panoramic world exploration. Perception-oriented datasets such as 360VOT/360VOTS ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) , PanoVOS ( Yan et al., 2024 ) , and Leader360V ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) provide tracking or segmentation annotations, but are not designed for world exploration. In contrast, MUGEN is the first dataset with large-scale real-world 360° videos, minute-level duration, high visual fidelity, semantic labels, and geometric annotations including camera trajectories, depth, and instance masks to support interactive world exploration.

paragraphs.en: Recent panoramic video generation methods adapt general video priors to ERP geometry using panorama-specific adapters ( Wang et al., 2024 ) , scalable generation ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , spherical or panorama-aware representations ( Park et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Xia et al., 2025 ) , and perspective-to-panorama lifting ( Tan et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2026 ) . These works improve visual fidelity and scene coverage, but ERP panoramic video generation still requires geometry-aware mechanisms to handle longitude periodicity, boundary artifacts, and yaw-equivalent observations. Wan360 achieves higher-quality panoramic video generation through three parameter-free ERP-aware components that address these geometric properties. These components share related geometric intuitions with several prior works, but differ in how they are formulated and applied. PanoSplatt3R ( Ren et al., 2025 ) approximates ERP periodicity through head-wise rolled linear RoPE coordinates. In contrast, our Periodic Longitude RoPE is exactly cyclic for every head, leading to better continuity at the seam. PAR ( Wang et al., 2026a ) applies circular padding to panoramic image generation, whereas we extend it to the 3D video VAE for video generation. PanoDiffusion ( Wu et al., 2024 ) rotates the panorama during training, our Random Roll Yaw also rotates the camera trajectory simultaneously, thereby enhancing the diversity of camera trajectories during training.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的全景视频生成方法通过使用全景专用的适配器（Wang et al., 2024）、可扩展生成（Liu et al., 2025）、球面或全景感知表示（Park et al., 2026; Zhang et al., 2025a; Xie et al., 2025; Xia et al., 2025）以及从透视图到全景的提升（Tan et al., 2025; Lu et al., 2025; Fang et al., 2025; Li et al., 2025a; Li et al., 2026），将通用视频先验适配到 ERP 几何结构上。 这些工作提升了视觉保真度和场景覆盖范围，但 ERP 全景视频生成仍需要几何感知机制来处理经度周期性、边界伪影以及偏航等价观测。 Wan360 通过三个无参数的 ERP 感知组件来解决这些几何特性，从而实现更高质量的全景视频生成。 这些组件与先前的一些工作共享相关的几何直觉，但在公式化方式和应用方式上有所不同。 PanoSplatt3R（Ren et al., 2025）通过逐头滚动的线性 RoPE 坐标来近似 ERP 周期性。 相比之下，我们的周期经度 RoPE 对每个头都是严格循环的，从而在接缝处带来更好的连续性。 PAR（Wang et al., 2026a）将循环填充应用于全景图像生成，而我们则将其扩展到用于视频生成的 3D 视频 VAE 中。 PanoDiffusion（Wu et al., 2024）在训练期间旋转全景图，而我们的随机滚动偏航还同时对相机轨迹进行旋转，从而增强了训练期间相机轨迹的多样性。

paragraphs.en: To address the lack of large-scale, high-quality, richly annotated panoramic video datasets tailored to world exploration, we introduce MUGEN. Figure 2 presents the data curation pipeline for our MUGEN dataset. We begin by collecting panoramic videos from YouTube, focusing on diverse real-world environments. To ensure high data fidelity, we apply strict format filtering based on resolution, bitrate, and frame rate. The filtered videos are then preprocessed into minute-level clips through intro/outro trimming, shot boundary detection, and standardized transcoding. Each clip is annotated with comprehensive semantic and geometric information using multimodal models, followed by content-based quality filtering to produce the final MUGEN dataset. Furthermore, we construct MUGEN-HQ by sampling a high-quality subset with the most reliable and diverse annotations. MUGEN also provides panoramic video supervision for AlayaVista ( Tan et al., 2026 ) , which studies streaming world modeling from panoramic states to perspective observations.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决缺乏面向世界探索的大规模、高质量、丰富标注的全景视频数据集这一问题，我们提出了 MUGEN。 图 2 展示了 MUGEN 数据集的数据构建流程。 我们首先从 YouTube 收集全景视频，重点关注多样化的真实世界环境。 为确保数据的高保真度，我们基于分辨率、比特率和帧率进行严格的格式筛选。 筛选后的视频随后经过片头/片尾剪切、镜头边界检测和标准化转码，被预处理为分钟级片段。 利用多模态模型，每个片段都被标注上全面的语义与几何信息，随后通过基于内容的质量筛选，最终生成 MUGEN 数据集。 此外，我们通过采样标注最可靠、最多样的高质量子集，构建了 MUGEN-HQ。 MUGEN 还为 AlayaVista（Tan et al., 2026）提供了全景视频监督，该工作研究了从全景状态到透视观测的流式世界建模。

paragraphs.en: We further query video metadata and apply format filtering to retain high-fidelity panoramic videos. We remove non-panoramic videos and videos with frame rates below 30 FPS, resolutions below 4K, or bitrates below 4 kbps. For the remaining videos, we download the highest available resolution and best-quality audio, resulting in 2,893 hours of raw panoramic footage. All retained source videos are longer than one minute.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步查询视频元数据并进行格式过滤，以保留高保真全景视频。 我们移除非全景视频，以及帧率低于 30 FPS、分辨率低于 4K 或码率低于 4 kbps 的视频。 对于剩余的视频，我们下载可用的最高分辨率和最佳质量的音频，最终得到 2,893 小时的原始全景素材。 所有保留的源视频时长均超过一分钟。

paragraphs.en: For preprocessing, we first verify file integrity and discard corrupted videos. We trim the first and last minute of each source video to remove common intro and outro segments. Because online videos are often edited, we use TransNetV2 ( Souček and Lokoč, 2020 ) to detect shot boundaries and keep only temporally continuous segments. Following Sekai ( Li et al., 2025b ) , we accelerate shot-boundary processing with PyNvVideoCodec and CVCUDA. Each continuous segment is partitioned into consecutive non-overlapping 60-second clips, which makes large-scale annotation tractable and provides a consistent training unit. The clips are transcoded to H.265 at the original resolution and frame rate, with audio re-encoded to AAC at 48 kHz. This process produces 137,209 one-minute clips totaling approximately 2,287 hours before content filtering.
paragraphs.zh: 在预处理阶段，我们首先验证文件完整性，并丢弃损坏的视频。 我们将每个源视频的开头和结尾各剪去一分钟，以去除常见的片头和片尾片段。 由于网络视频通常经过剪辑，我们使用 TransNetV2（Souček and Lokoč, 2020）检测镜头边界，仅保留时间上连续的片段。 参照 Sekai（Li et al., 2025b）的做法，我们使用 PyNvVideoCodec 和 CVCUDA 加速镜头边界处理。 每个连续片段被划分为连续且不重叠的 60 秒剪辑，这使得大规模标注切实可行，并提供了统一的训练单元。 这些剪辑被转码为 H.265 格式，保持原始分辨率和帧率，音频被重新编码为 48 kHz 的 AAC。 该流程共生成 137,209 个一分钟剪辑，总计约 2,287 小时，此为内容过滤前的数据量。

paragraphs.en: MUGEN provides two groups of annotations: semantic annotations for content generation and geometric annotations for interactive camera control.
paragraphs.zh: MUGEN 提供两组标注：用于内容生成的语义标注和用于交互式相机控制的几何标注。

paragraphs.en: Because ERP panoramas are difficult for vision-language models to parse directly, we project each ERP clip into six cube faces with a 90° × \times 90° field of view and attach explicit face labels. We use Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct ( Yang et al., 2025 ) to generate detailed clip-level narratives of approximately 250 words, describing scene layout, visible objects, events, and camera motion. To support different training and evaluation settings, we also provide event-agnostic captions and interval captions at 5s/10s granularity. We further prompt Qwen3-VL with YouTube metadata to predict structured attributes, including weather, time of day, crowd density, scene category, and action. Following SpatialVID ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , we refine coarse indoor/outdoor labels into fine-grained scene categories and introduce action labels tailored to world exploration. For geographic information, we use GPT-4o ( Hurst et al., 2024 ) to extract location tags from video metadata; clips with ambiguous or missing locations are marked as unspecified .
paragraphs.zh: 由于 ERP 全景图对视觉-语言模型而言难以直接解析，我们将每个 ERP 片段投影为六个视场角为 90° × \times 90° 的立方体面，并附上明确的面标签。 我们使用 Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct（Yang et al., 2025）生成约 250 词的详细片段级叙述，描述场景布局、可见物体、事件和相机运动。 为支持不同的训练与评估设置，我们还提供了与事件无关的描述以及 5 秒/10 秒粒度的区间描述。 我们进一步结合 YouTube 元数据提示 Qwen3-VL 预测结构化属性，包括天气、一天中的时间、人群密度、场景类别和动作。 沿用 SpatialVID（Wang et al., 2026b）的做法，我们将粗粒度的室内/室外标签细化为细粒度的场景类别，并引入面向世界探索定制的动作标签。 在地理信息方面，我们使用 GPT-4o（Hurst et al., 2024）从视频元数据中提取位置标签；位置模糊或缺失的片段被标记为 unspecified。

paragraphs.en: For camera-controllable generation, each clip requires trajectory annotations. We compare VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , MegaSAM ( Li et al., 2025c ) , and ViPE ( Huang et al., 2025 ) on sampled panoramic clips, and choose ViPE because it directly supports panoramic video input and produces more coherent camera trajectories in our setting. We use ViPE to estimate camera trajectories, instance masks, and depth for each clip. Generating geometric annotations for the full dataset requires over 30,000 GPU hours.
paragraphs.zh: 对于相机可控生成，每个片段都需要轨迹标注。 我们在采样的全景片段上比较了 VGGT（Wang et al., 2025）、MegaSAM（Li et al., 2025c）和 ViPE（Huang et al., 2025），并选择 ViPE，因为它直接支持全景视频输入，并且在我们的设置中能生成更连贯的相机轨迹。 我们使用 ViPE 为每个片段估计相机轨迹、实例掩码和深度。 为完整数据集生成几何标注需要超过 30,000 GPU 小时。

sents.en: For camera-controllable generation, each clip requires trajectory annotations.
sents.zh: 对于相机可控生成，每个片段都需要轨迹标注。

paragraphs.en: Raw web videos inevitably contain poor lighting, blur, overlays, stitching artifacts, or unreliable trajectories. We therefore apply four content filters before forming MUGEN.
paragraphs.zh: 原始网络视频不可避免地存在光照不佳、模糊、叠加元素、拼接伪影或不可靠的轨迹。 因此，在构建 MUGEN 之前，我们应用了四种内容过滤器。

sents.en: Raw web videos inevitably contain poor lighting, blur, overlays, stitching artifacts, or unreliable trajectories.
sents.zh: 原始网络视频不可避免地存在光照不佳、模糊、叠加元素、拼接伪影或不可靠的轨迹。

sents.en: We therefore apply four content filters before forming MUGEN.
sents.zh: 因此，在构建 MUGEN 之前，我们应用了四种内容过滤器。

paragraphs.en: We compute the mean luma value of each clip and discard clips outside the range [40, 215] to remove underexposed or overexposed content.
paragraphs.zh: 我们计算每个剪辑的平均亮度值，并丢弃范围 [40, 215] 之外的剪辑，以移除曝光不足或曝光过度的内容。

paragraphs.en: We score clips with COVER ( He et al., 2024 ) and remove clips below 0.7, which typically contain severe blur, distortion, or compression artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 COVER（He et al., 2024）对视频片段进行评分，并移除低于 0.7 的片段，这些片段通常包含严重的模糊、失真或压缩伪影。

paragraphs.en: We project each ERP clip into six perspective views and use Qwen3-VL ( Yang et al., 2025 ) to flag subtitles, watermarks, and nadir patches.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将每个 ERP 视频片段投影为六个透视视角，并使用 Qwen3-VL（Yang 等，2025）来标记字幕、水印和天底图像块。

paragraphs.en: We filter clips whose estimated camera trajectories contain chaotic paths, temporal discontinuities, or abnormal rotations. After filtering, MUGEN contains 1,318 hours of high-quality one-minute clips from 6,446 unique source videos.
paragraphs.zh: 我们筛选掉估计相机轨迹包含混乱路径、时间不连续或异常旋转的视频片段。 过滤后，MUGEN 包含来自 6,446 个独立源视频的 1,318 小时高质量一分钟片段。

sents.en: We filter clips whose estimated camera trajectories contain chaotic paths, temporal discontinuities, or abnormal rotations.
sents.zh: 我们筛选掉估计相机轨迹包含混乱路径、时间不连续或异常旋转的视频片段。

sents.en: After filtering, MUGEN contains 1,318 hours of high-quality one-minute clips from 6,446 unique source videos.
sents.zh: 过滤后，MUGEN 包含来自 6,446 个独立源视频的 1,318 小时高质量一分钟片段。

paragraphs.en: Although MUGEN is suitable for large-scale training and evaluation, model development often requires a smaller subset with high visual quality and balanced coverage. We therefore construct MUGEN-HQ, a 300-hour subset used for training Wan360. We first rank clips by COVER score and retain the top 70% as a quality-filtered pool. We then perform stratified sampling across scene categories, camera-motion patterns, action types, and weather conditions. This strategy preserves high visual quality while improving diversity in both scene content and controllable camera motion. MUGEN-HQ contains clips from 4,023 unique source videos.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然 MUGEN 适合大规模训练与评估，但模型开发往往需要一个规模更小、视觉质量高且覆盖均衡的子集。 因此，我们构建了 MUGEN-HQ，这是一个用于训练 Wan360 的 300 小时子集。 我们首先按 COVER 分数对片段进行排序，保留前 70% 作为经过质量筛选的片段池。 然后我们在场景类别、相机运动模式、动作类型和天气条件等维度上进行分层采样。 该策略在保持高视觉质量的同时，提升了场景内容和可控相机运动两方面的多样性。 MUGEN-HQ 包含来自 4,023 个独立源视频的片段。

paragraphs.en: MUGEN covers diverse semantic and motion conditions for panoramic world exploration. As shown in Figure 3 , the dataset spans multiple weather types, times of day, crowd-density levels, scene categories, and action types. The trajectory statistics show substantial variation in translation length, rotation magnitude, angular speed, and dominant motion direction. These properties provide the semantic diversity and trajectory diversity needed to train and evaluate camera-controllable panoramic generation models. We will release metadata and processing scripts to support transparent reuse.
paragraphs.zh: MUGEN 涵盖用于全景世界探索的多样化语义与运动条件。 如图 3 所示，该数据集涵盖多种天气类型、一天中的不同时段、人群密度水平、场景类别和动作类型。 轨迹统计数据显示，平移长度、旋转幅度、角速度和主导运动方向均存在显著变化。 这些特性提供了训练和评估相机可控全景生成模型所需的语义多样性与轨迹多样性。 我们将发布元数据和处理脚本，以支持透明的复用。

paragraphs.en: We present Wan360 , a panoramic image-to-video (I2V) generation model that generates ERP videos from an input panorama, a text prompt, and a user-specified camera trajectory. Wan360 is fine-tuned from a perspective camera-control video generation baseline to preserve its strong generation and control priors, but this baseline cannot be directly applied to panoramas. ERP videos contain cyclic longitude seams and pole singularities, and panoramic cameras do not follow the perspective pinhole model. Naive fine-tuning would therefore introduce seam artifacts, spherical inconsistencies, and mismatched camera-control signals.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 Wan360，这是一个全景图生视频（I2V）生成模型，可根据输入的全景图、文本提示以及用户指定的相机轨迹生成 ERP 视频。 Wan360 由透视相机控制视频生成基线模型微调而来，以保留其强大的生成与控制先验，但该基线无法直接应用于全景图。 ERP 视频包含循环经度接缝和极点奇异性，且全景相机不遵循透视针孔模型。 因此，朴素的微调会引入接缝伪影、球面不一致以及相机控制信号不匹配的问题。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows the overall architecture. Wan360 addresses the ERP geometry mismatch with three components that add no trainable parameters. Periodic Longitude RoPE ( Section 4.2 ) makes longitude positional encoding seam-consistent, ERP-Aware Padding ( Section 4.3 ) reduces boundary artifacts in VAE encoding and decoding, and Random Roll Yaw ( Section 4.4 ) creates yaw-equivalent panorama-trajectory training pairs. For camera control, a Panoramic Plücker Embedding ( Section 4.5 ) replaces the baseline’s pinhole ray-condition generator with an ERP ray generator, enabling intrinsics-free trajectory conditioning.
paragraphs.zh: 图 4 展示了整体架构。 Wan360 通过三个不增加可训练参数的组件来解决 ERP 几何不匹配问题。 周期经度 RoPE（第 4.2 节）使经度位置编码具有接缝一致性，ERP 感知填充（第 4.3 节）减少 VAE 编码和解码中的边界伪影，随机滚动偏航（第 4.4 节）创建偏航等价的全景轨迹训练对。 在相机控制方面，全景 Plücker 嵌入（第 4.5 节）用 ERP 射线生成器替代基线的针孔射线条件生成器，实现无需内参的轨迹条件控制。

sents.zh: 图 4 展示了整体架构。

paragraphs.en: We conduct a user study to evaluate the annotation quality of MUGEN from three complementary aspects: long-form text descriptions, structured category labels, and camera trajectories. We randomly sample 1,000 one-minute clips from MUGEN and recruit 10 volunteers for human verification. For each aspect, every sampled clip is independently reviewed by all 10 volunteers. An annotation is considered valid if at least seven volunteers judge it to be correct or usable.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开展了一项用户研究，从三个互补的方面评估 MUGEN 的标注质量：长文本描述、结构化类别标签和相机轨迹。 我们从 MUGEN 中随机抽取 1,000 个一分钟片段，并招募 10 名志愿者进行人工验证。 对于每个方面，每个被抽取的片段都由全部 10 名志愿者独立审阅。 如果至少有七名志愿者判定某条标注正确或可用，则该标注被视为有效。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we take a step toward interactive panoramic world exploration, where the central goal is to generate immersive 360° videos that remain coherent while following user-specified camera trajectories in dynamic real-world scenes. This task requires both suitable annotated data and a model that can respect panoramic geometry under camera control. To this end, MUGEN provides large-scale, high-quality real-world panoramic videos with rich semantic and geometric annotations, including explicit camera trajectories for controllable generation. Built on MUGEN, Wan360 fine-tunes a perspective camera-control video generation baseline for ERP panoramas through periodic longitude RoPE, ERP-aware padding, random roll yaw, and a panoramic Plücker embedding. Experiments show that MUGEN provides effective data support for the task, and that Wan360 generates panoramic videos with strong visual quality, temporal coherence, and trajectory controllability. The proposed MUGEN and Wan360 establish a practical foundation for camera-controlled interactive panoramic world exploration in real-world environments.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们朝着交互式全景世界探索迈出了一步，其核心目标是生成沉浸式360°视频，使其在动态真实世界场景中遵循用户指定的相机轨迹的同时保持连贯性。 该任务既需要合适的标注数据，也需要一个能够在相机控制下遵循全景几何的模型。 为此，MUGEN 提供了大规模、高质量的真实世界全景视频，并附带丰富的语义与几何标注，包括用于可控生成的显式相机轨迹。 基于 MUGEN，Wan360 通过周期性经度 RoPE、ERP 感知填充、随机滚动偏航以及全景 Plücker 嵌入，对透视相机控制视频生成基线进行微调，使其适用于 ERP 全景。 实验表明，MUGEN 为该任务提供了有效的数据支持，而 Wan360 生成的全景视频具有出色的视觉质量、时间连贯性和轨迹可控性。 所提出的 MUGEN 和 Wan360 为真实世界环境中相机控制的交互式全景世界探索奠定了实用基础。

paragraphs.en: We use ViPE ( Huang et al., 2025 ) to perform 3D reconstruction on videos generated by Wan360. In static scenes, the reconstructed scene structure and relative object positions remain generally stable, while the estimated camera trajectories are smooth and continuous. However, strict 3D consistency is not guaranteed, particularly in dynamic scenes with independently moving objects. Explicitly enforcing geometric and temporal consistency remains an important direction for future work. Wan360 currently generates fixed-length clips and does not yet support real-time or unbounded long-horizon generation, where error accumulation remains an open challenge. In addition, MUGEN’s data primarily comes from the real world. In future work, we will consider extending it to other domains, such as animation and games.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 ViPE（Huang et al., 2025）对 Wan360 生成的视频进行三维重建。 在静态场景中，重建的场景结构和物体的相对位置总体保持稳定，同时估计的相机轨迹平滑且连续。 然而，严格的3D一致性并未得到保证，尤其是在包含独立运动物体的动态场景中。 显式地保证几何一致性和时间一致性仍然是未来工作的一个重要方向。 Wan360 目前只能生成固定长度的片段，尚不支持实时或无界的长时程生成，误差累积仍是一个悬而未决的挑战。 此外，MUGEN 的数据主要来自真实世界。 在未来的工作中，我们将考虑将其扩展到其他领域，例如动画和游戏。
